messages:
Alex: RiverWorks onboarding — they see intermittent 401s on SDK init and occasional 429s when their fleet warms up. Started after they switched to ephemeral tokens. Any quick triage?
Priya: 401s + 429s together usually mean mis-timed token rotation + client-side fanout. If many workers refresh at once, we can get auth fails and then a surge of retries causing 429s. Which SDK and refresh cadence?
Alex: They're on node-sdk v2.0.1, token agent rotates every 45s. Fanout is ~40 concurrent lambdas during startup.
Linh: Two paths: (1) clock skew -> 401s, (2) JWKS cache TTL + rotation -> signature fails. Also 40 simultaneous refreshes could overwhelm our auth endpoint or edge and trigger rate limits.
Alex: Asked for failing request headers and X-Request-Id. Got back Date header showing host ~30s behind, and lots of identical request-ids from their side during warmup.
Priya: Clock drift explain 401s. Actionable: sync NTP on hosts and stagger token refreshes. For SDK we recommend jittered refresh and a lease buffer (rotate at 70% of lifetime).
Linh: For server-side mitigation: we already accept small clock skew but not >60s. We can add clearer 429 reason headers to help clients distinguish auth vs rate throttle.
Alex: Customer applied chrony and reduced fanout. They also implemented a small local refresh jitter. 401s dropped to zero, 429 spikes reduced significantly.
Priya: We'll add an onboarding KB note: "When using ephemeral tokens and serverless fanout, ensure system clock sync, stagger refreshes with jitter, and set refresh threshold < token lifetime to avoid rotation storms."
infra-bot: Note created: onboarding/kb/ephemeral-token-fanout-v1 created by Priya at 2026-01-12T12:05:00Z
Linh: Tech follow-up: propose SDK opt-in update to support refresh jitter and exponential backoff for init requests. Priya can you file a ticket?
Priya: Filed ticket CS-4821: SDK refresh jitter + init backoff. Will track with SDK team.
Alex: Marking thread resolved from CS side. Will reopen if they see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
